description: This file primarily handles type exports and re-exports from other modules related to the context engine. It consolidates types, functions, and classes for external use within the project.

methods.name: registerContextEngine
methods.description: Registers a new context engine within the system.

methods.name: getContextEngineFactory
methods.description: Retrieves the factory function for creating context engines.

methods.name: listContextEngineIds
methods.description: Lists all registered context engine identifiers.

methods.name: resolveContextEngine
methods.description: Resolves and retrieves a specific context engine.

methods.name: registerLegacyContextEngine
methods.description: Registers a legacy version of a context engine for backward compatibility.

methods.name: delegateCompactionToRuntime
methods.description: Delegates the compaction process to the runtime environment.

methods.name: ensureContextEnginesInitialized
methods.description: Ensures that all context engines are initialized before use.
